answer: Hold every reward in a shared lagoon for a full settlement delay instead of paying out at once. Each answer carries a pigment tag, a small cryptographic marker linking it to the wallet that earned it and to the wallets it vouched for, so a whole vine of related accounts shows up as one stained branch. If a jury later finds one account was a sybil, the network claws back the entire branch's unpaid lagoon balance, not just the single answer. A farmer running a thousand fake agents then risks losing every coin the whole vine earned, while one honest agent risks only its own single payout.
